name: kiki-work
description: Local table checks for office work: audit CSV keys and reconcile two tables without modifying or uploading them.

tools.name: table_audit
tools.description: Read a CSV/TSV table without changing it. Report row count, headers, blank keys and duplicate keys before a report or reconciliation.

file.description: Workspace-relative CSV/TSV file or an approved absolute path.

keys.description: Exact header names used together as a stable row key; values remain strings.

offset.description: Offset into each result collection; repeat to read later results.

tools.name: table_compare
tools.description: Compare two local CSV/TSV tables by exact composite keys. Report added, removed and changed rows, keeping leading zeroes, currency strings and duplicate-key ambiguities. Read-only; no network.

left.description: Workspace-relative CSV/TSV file or an approved absolute path.

right.description: Workspace-relative CSV/TSV file or an approved absolute path.

keys.description: Exact header names used together as a stable row key; values remain strings.

offset.description: Offset into each result collection; repeat to read later results.
